fomod.Name: Bard Hero
fomod.Author: Mern
fomod.Description: Turns Skyrim's bard performances into a five-fret rhythm game. Equip a lute, flute or drum through Skyrim's Got Talent, pick a song, and play it on a live note highway with scoring, Star Power and a crowd that reacts to how well you play. An optional addon adds the Doom Lute, an electric guitar you forge at the Atronach Forge.
